issues.description: In the template repository, `ray_sphere_intersect` is declared in `example_program/src/ray_sphere_intersect.h` as returning `int`, but its implementation in `example_program/src/ray_sphere_intersect.cpp` returns `bool`. This creates an inconsistent API contract (predicate vs. integer return) and can confuse students and/or trigger compiler errors depending on toolchain/settings and call-site expectations.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template header match the implementation by changing the declaration in `example_program/src/ray_sphere_intersect.h` to `bool ray_sphere_intersect(...)` (recommended, since the function is used as a boolean predicate).
